description: Cited spinal coupling-law data (SPN-3, #12743). Literature numbers are copied from docs/research/segmental_spine/data_extraction.md; the loader derives per-level matrices from them. Pending entries carry no numbers.

citation.source: Bruno AG, Bouxsein ML, Anderson DE. J Biomech Eng 137(8):081003 (2015), PMC5101035
citation.table: Section 2.1 regional motion split (extraction Table B1)

laws.assumptions: Within each region the published regional share is distributed uniformly across the region's levels (equal share per level). This within-region uniformity is an assumption of this repository, not a published per-level result. Lumbar = L5-S1..L1-L2 (5 levels); thoracic = T12-L1..T1-T2 (12 levels), following SpinalLevel.region. No cross-axis coupling terms. Independent coordinates are the global pelvis-to-thorax ISB flexion, lateral bending and axial rotation.
laws.notes: Regional splits from the main text of Bruno 2015 (51/49 flexion, 27/73 lateral bending, 17/83 axial). Per-level Supplemental Table 2 is not used (see bruno2015_per_level).

citation.source: Fujii R, Sakaura H, Mukai Y, et al. Eur Spine J 16(11):1867-1874 (2007), PMC2223353
citation.table: Results text, per-segment motion at 45 deg trunk rotation (extraction Table F1)

laws.assumptions: Segment angles measured at 45 deg of trunk rotation are scaled linearly to a gain per degree of trunk rotation (deg/deg); linearity in rotation is an assumption. Signs are carried as published (coupled flexion positive = flexion; coupled lateral bending negative = opposite to the trunk rotation direction) and are mapped directly onto ISB flexion and lateral-bending angle signs for a positive axial rotation; the ISB sign mapping was not verified against the paper. Per-segment SDs are kept in the rows but not used. T12/L1 is included as the cranial end of the measured range. The single independent coordinate is trunk axial rotation; this is not a share law (gains do not sum to 1).
laws.notes: Verified from the PMC full text (two agreeing extractions); a PDF re-check is recommended per the extraction file. DOI not retrieved.

laws.assumptions: Each of the 17 levels carries an equal share (1/17) of the global flexion, lateral bending and axial rotation, with no cross-axis terms. A synthetic baseline for comparison and tests only.
laws.notes: Labelled reference law; not a physiological claim.
